steps.title: Define Project Specifications
steps.description: Set target SDK to 34, compile SDK to 34, and Java version to 17 compat mode.

steps.title: Establish Android Manifest
steps.description: Configure standard permissions, package name, application attributes, and MainActivity configuration.

steps.title: Design Layout Architecture
steps.description: Build dynamic UI layout with standard Material Design containing standard calculator, Kaprekar constant calculator, and interactive Mind Reader sections.

steps.title: Implement Tab Switcher System
steps.description: Code custom layout-visibility based tab system to switch seamlessly between sections in MainActivity.

steps.title: Develop Mathematical Calculator Engine
steps.description: Develop interactive key inputs, screen display logic, and evaluation algorithms for basic math operations.

steps.title: Build Kaprekar's Routine Engine
steps.description: Implement the 6174 constant steps visualizer engine. Sorts digits, subtracts, and outputs intermediate steps visually.

steps.title: Construct Mind Reader Binary Algorithm
steps.description: Program the binary search algorithm for card-based mental mind reading with fully dynamic 6-step card generation logic.

steps.title: Set Visual Enhancements and Animations
steps.description: Integrate dynamic card indicators, success animations, color toggles, and results popups for math magic revealing.

steps.title: Validate Java 8 Compatibility
steps.description: Review Java codebase to ensure zero lambdas or modern streams are used, matching constraints of build environment.

steps.title: Building Magic Math Calculator
steps.description: Compiling resources and building the release-ready package file.
